_readme: Settings for the test report generator. Edit values, keep the structure.
Cell names (D7, J24, ...) are the cells of templates/test_report.xlsx; PDF and Word use the same layout.
In texts, \n is a line break, ^{2} is a superscript 2 (Kgs/Cm^{2}) and ✆ is the phone sign (Wingdings).
Random ranges: min and max are both possible; 'decimals' is how many decimals are printed;
'step' (optional) is the smallest change, e.g. 0.05 gives values like 1.55 or 2.30, 5 gives 600, 605, 610.

_help: One profile per company. 'selected' is the default in the website's Company menu.
Each company has its own template (same table, its own header in rows 1-5). Header texts are given by cell;
a cell given here replaces the fixed text of that cell ('' leaves it empty, e.g. G39 'Tested by :-').
images: pictures placed on the page: cell = top-left cell, dx/dy = points right/down from it, height in points.
template_layout: how tools/make_company_template.py builds the template from templates/test_report.xlsx
(row heights, merged header cells, font size and bold). Run it after changing a company's header.

report._help: Report No. (D7) is the production row's column D (REPORT NO.), e.g. MP63/171. Editable before generating. Certificates are made in grade order (PE 63, then PE 80, then PE 100, top to bottom).
report.file_name: Production column D (REPORT NO.) with / replaced by -, e.g. MP100/019 -> MP100-019

_help: Report 2, the testing record: several entries side by side, one per column (D, E, F, G), all in one Excel file.
Each row takes the value Report 1 prints in the given Report 1 cell, so both reports show the same values.
'grade_number' = the grade without 'PE' (63, 80, 100). Rows not listed (18-24 and 34 'Signature of QCI') stay empty.
Same for every company. Template built by tools/make_report2_template.py.

header_cells._help: Where each value from the production row goes.

chart_cells._help: Specification limits looked up in the IS 4984 weight chart (data/is4984_chart.json) by DN and SDR.

random_values._help: Test values obtained. New random values every time a report is generated.

stripe_width._help: Size (DN) up to dn_limit uses the first range, bigger sizes the second.

stripe_depth._help: Chart wall minimum (E26) up to wall_limit mm: below 0.20 (spec 0.20); above it: below 0.45 (spec 0.50).

pipe_end._help: From half the chart's Pipe End maximum (E20) to half + width_above_half: max 2 -> 1.00-1.50, 3 -> 1.50-2.00, 5 -> 2.50-3.00, 7 -> 3.50-4.00. Ends in 0 or 5.

outside_diameter._help: Both inside the chart OD min-max (E24-E25), never exactly on a limit; obtained maximum is at least min_gap_fraction of the chart range above the minimum.

wall_thickness._help: Both inside the chart wall min-max (E26-E27), never exactly on a limit; obtained maximum is at least min_gap_fraction of the chart range above the minimum.

ovality._help: 20% to 50% of the chart maximum (E28), ends in 0 or 5.

melt_flow_rate._help: Ranges must not overlap so PE 100 < PE 80 < PE 63 always holds.

coiling._help: Size (DN) up to dn_limit: 18 x DN + 50 to 18 x DN + 100 (DN 50 -> 950-1000). Bigger sizes print text_above_limit.

fixed_values._help: Test values that are always the same text (the template keeps these cells empty).

fixed_text._help: Every fixed text of the report. Same on every report.
fixed_text.D14:
